title: Shiraishi An — Waving With A Smile〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: New York City - Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, this park's gigantic!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is. Not only is there plenty of greenery, it offers nice views. You could spend a whole day here without ever getting bored.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
It's popular for jogging and picnics and stuff too.
Some people even come from around the world just to see this park!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
Since we're here, why don't we all take a look around?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: That sounds nice. We probably don't have time to see everything, but we can probably split up and cover one or two areas.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm game!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I saw a map of the park over there.
Let's go see what it has to offer!
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow...! This place has tennis courts and an obstacle course! And these basketball courts are really well-kept too!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Just seeing them makes me want to exercise.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean!
I pass by here from time to time during my runs, but people who are practicing always seem to wanna talk...
“Oh, Slade!”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
“Right on cue... Hey!
Are you three here to shoot some hoops again today?”

rows.Speaker: Basketball Player B
rows.Line: “Yup! Wait, you're here with Rebecca from illys?! But I don't recognize your other friends...”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Oh, nice to meet you...! I'm An Shiraishi!”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: “She's visiting from Japan, and she's one heck of a singer!”

rows.Speaker: Basketball Player B
rows.Line: “Really? She must be good if you're willing to say that, Slade!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Come listen to us if you ever get a chance. We guarantee you'll be amazed!”

rows.Speaker: Basketball Player A
rows.Line: “Hey, wait a second. There's three of them...”

rows.Speaker: Basketball Player A
rows.Line:
“Hey!
Wanna play some three-on-three with us?”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I definitely wasn't expecting this.
Who'd guess the three of us would end up playing basketball?

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
I know, right?
Anyway, let's just have fun with it.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: I promise not to miss, so don't be afraid to pass me the ball from wherever! The first team to lead by two buckets wins, so let's try to close things out fast!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That being said, they're making it hard to pass the ball to him. I think I have to find my own way around them...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Oh, I have an opening!)
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Whoa, nice fake! That was a total ankle breaker...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Alright, I'm through!
Now I just have to... Oh!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Becky's in a good spot!
If I pass it to her for now, and—)
se_run_women_001_1
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Over here! Pass it back to me!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Okay! Lay it in, An!

rows.Speaker: An & Rebecca
rows.Line:
Yay!
Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Wow! Nice one, An!
You got that bucket for us so fast!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I have to thank Becky for going along with me so well.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: No, you did most of the work.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
That fake you did to get by was so cool!
Did you used to play basketball or something?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
A little bit.
I used to play one-on-one a lot against this one girl.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
Oh, you had a rival?
I bet she could really move too.

rows.Speaker: Basketball Player B
rows.Line:
“Nice one...!
But we'll stop you guys next time!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
This isn't good. I can't find a way past them.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: They've all been keeping a really close eye on you, An.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: After seeing what she can do, it's no wonder they're locking her down. They've locked in now too.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Yeah. They've tied our score now too... We might be in trouble.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that's it!
I think I've got a good play!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huddle up, you guys.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Great, time to start the play! Slade's got the ball, so he'll draw their attention...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'll slip away while they're all focused on Slade!)
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Basketball Player A
rows.Line: “No, don't let her go free!”

rows.Speaker: Basketball Player B
rows.Line: “She's running towards Slade! I think she's gonna take the ball from him!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That means they're gonna start coming after me. But!)

rows.Speaker: An & Slade
rows.Line: “Becky!”

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Nice pass! Leave the rest to me!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca, An & Slade
rows.Line: “We win!”

rows.Speaker: Basketball Player A
rows.Line: “How'd you guys pull that off at the end?!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Hehe. We were in perfect sync, right?!”

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: “We really got you guys there! An came up with that play!”

rows.Speaker: Basketball Player A
rows.Line: “This is so frustrating! I want a rematch, but...”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Sorry, we need to go meet back up with the others!”

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: As for our rematch, it'll have to wait until the next time you visit the US, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll be looking forward to that!
